design: SU/SD within DECSTBM margins, cursor unchanged, Ps default/0->1, clamp to region; blank lines use cursor.attrs when non-default; SU pushes to history.top, SD to history.bottom (pyte index/reverse_index parity); dirty rows in region; active screen only (alt-aware); private or 5-param CSI T ignored; TerminalByteStream(pyte.ByteStream) adds S/T to csi table; make_stream returns it.
gaps: history push also for partial margins (pyte style) whereas xterm saves scrollback only for full-screen region
BCE uses whole cursor.attrs per pyte erase convention
